from unittest.mock import Mock
from larder.reminders import remind

send_sms = Mock()
send_email = Mock()
remind('+351900000000', 'member@example.com', 'tomorrow at 10:00', send_sms, send_email)
send_email.assert_called_once_with('member@example.com', 'Your pantry order is ready for pickup tomorrow at 10:00.')
send_sms.assert_not_called()
print('Verified pickup reminder uses email and sends no SMS.')
